metadata.title: Android Runtime (ART) — Detailed Connected Knowledge Graph
metadata.description: A detailed, connected machine-readable knowledge graph of Android Runtime architecture, bytecode, compilation, memory management, profiling, history, tooling, security, platform integration, and performance trade-offs.
metadata.source_basis: User-provided Wikipedia article on Android Runtime; distinctions beyond that article are included as explanatory context and marked where release support is version-dependent.
metadata.primary_source_citation: User-provided source lines 43-126, especially overview lines 67-91 and references/official links lines 99-126.
notes: ART's concrete compilation policy and implementation details vary by Android version and device configuration.
RISC-V is listed in the supplied article; actual deployment support is version- and device-dependent.

The graph preserves the article's central history: KitKat preview, Lollipop default replacement, Nougat hybrid JIT/AOT and OpenJDK transition, Pie cloud profiles/compressed DEX, Baseline Profiles, and Android 13 GC changes.

entities.name: Android Runtime (ART)
entities.description: Android's application runtime environment that executes Android application code, translating DEX bytecode into native instructions using a combination of interpretation, just-in-time compilation, and ahead-of-time compilation.

entities.name: Android operating system
entities.description: Operating system platform that integrates ART with application framework services, Linux kernel facilities, package management, process management, and system security.

entities.name: Android application
entities.description: An installable application package whose managed code is commonly distributed as DEX bytecode and executed by ART.

entities.name: Android application framework
entities.description: Platform APIs and system services used by Android apps, including lifecycle, UI, resources, content, and service abstractions.

entities.name: Android SDK
entities.description: Development tools, APIs, build utilities, and platform packages used to create, test, package, and debug Android applications.

entities.name: Android build system
entities.description: Build pipeline that compiles source code, transforms bytecode, packages resources and manifests, and produces APK or app bundle artifacts.

entities.name: Dalvik virtual machine
entities.description: ART's predecessor runtime, which executed DEX bytecode and introduced trace-based JIT compilation in Android 2.2.

entities.name: Dalvik Executable (DEX)
entities.description: Register-based bytecode format used to represent Android application code and packaged in DEX files.

entities.name: Android Package (APK)
entities.description: Android application installation package containing compiled code, resources, manifest, and related assets.

entities.name: Android App Bundle (AAB)
entities.description: Publishing format from which distribution systems can generate optimized APKs for device configurations.

entities.name: Executable and Linkable Format (ELF)
entities.description: Native executable and object-file format used for ART-generated compiled code and native libraries.

entities.name: dex2oat
entities.description: ART tool that compiles DEX bytecode into native code and produces ART-related compiled artifacts according to the device's compilation policy.

entities.name: ART service / runtime management
entities.description: System-managed facilities coordinating ART-related compilation, profile handling, and runtime updates across Android releases.

entities.name: Android application process
entities.description: Operating-system process in which an app's runtime instance, managed heap, threads, native libraries, and application components execute.

entities.name: ART runtime instance
entities.description: An initialized ART runtime associated with an application process, providing managed execution, class loading, memory management, and runtime services.

entities.name: Class loader
entities.description: Runtime mechanism that locates, defines, and loads classes from DEX or related code sources, subject to Android's class-loading rules.

entities.name: Class linker
entities.description: ART subsystem responsible for linking loaded classes, resolving types and methods, and coordinating class metadata and dispatch information.

entities.name: ART interpreter
entities.description: Execution engine that interprets DEX instructions when code has not been compiled or when interpretation is otherwise selected.

entities.name: ART JIT compiler
entities.description: Just-in-time compiler that compiles selected methods or code paths during execution, guided by runtime profiling and compilation policy.

entities.name: ART AOT compiler
entities.description: Ahead-of-time compiler path that translates selected DEX code into native machine code before execution, typically through installation, idle maintenance, or profile-guided workflows.

entities.name: ART compiler pipeline
entities.description: Compilation orchestration that applies compiler optimizations and emits target-specific native code for selected DEX methods.

entities.name: ART runtime linking and resolution
entities.description: Runtime mechanisms that resolve methods, fields, types, and native bindings needed to execute managed and native code.

entities.name: ART garbage collector
entities.description: Automatic memory manager that identifies unreachable managed objects and reclaims their heap storage, with collectors and policies evolving across Android versions.

entities.name: ART managed heap
entities.description: Memory region used for managed objects, with allocation, reachability, collection, and runtime metadata managed by ART.

entities.name: ART thread subsystem
entities.description: Runtime support for managed threads, thread state transitions, synchronization, stack management, and coordination with the operating system.

entities.name: Java Native Interface (JNI)
entities.description: Interface allowing managed Java/Kotlin code to call native code and native code to interact with managed objects and runtime services.

entities.name: Android native library
entities.description: Shared native code, commonly packaged as ABI-specific shared objects, that apps can load and call through JNI or other supported interfaces.

entities.name: Java runtime libraries on Android
entities.description: Core library APIs available to managed Android code; modern ART uses OpenJDK-derived library implementations rather than the discontinued Apache Harmony library.

entities.name: OpenJDK
entities.description: Open-source Java platform implementation whose library base replaced Apache Harmony in Android 7.0's Java runtime environment.

entities.name: Apache Harmony
entities.description: Earlier Java class-library implementation used by Android before the Android 7.0 transition to OpenJDK-derived libraries.

entities.name: Java
entities.description: A statically typed language commonly used for Android application development and compiled to JVM-style class files before conversion into DEX.

entities.name: Kotlin
entities.description: A statically typed language commonly used for Android development and compiled through the Android toolchain to DEX-compatible bytecode.

entities.name: Java compiler (javac)
entities.description: Compiler that translates Java source code into JVM class files as one stage of a typical Android Java build.

entities.name: Kotlin compiler
entities.description: Compiler that translates Kotlin source into JVM-compatible or other target bytecode, with Android builds subsequently transforming code for ART.

entities.name: D8 dexer
entities.description: Android build tool that converts JVM class files into DEX bytecode for Android packaging.

entities.name: R8 optimizer
entities.description: Android code shrinker and optimizer that can remove unused code, optimize bytecode, and perform obfuscation before DEX output.

entities.name: Gradle build system
entities.description: Build automation system commonly used by Android projects to coordinate compilation, optimization, resource processing, and packaging.

entities.name: Android package manager
entities.description: Installs, updates, verifies, and manages application packages and participates in the app installation and update lifecycle.

entities.name: Zygote process
entities.description: Android process that preloads common classes and resources and serves as a parent from which app processes are forked.

entities.name: Linux kernel
entities.description: Kernel beneath Android that provides process and thread scheduling, virtual memory, system calls, device drivers, and low-level isolation.

entities.name: ART Mainline module
entities.description: Android modularization mechanism that allows supported ART components to receive updates independently of a full system image update on compatible releases.

entities.name: ART profile data
entities.description: Runtime and build-time profile information used to identify frequently executed methods and classes and guide compilation decisions.

entities.name: Baseline Profiles
entities.description: App/library-supplied profile data that identifies important methods and classes for early optimization, reducing first-run performance costs.

entities.name: Google Play cloud profiles
entities.description: Aggregated profile data distributed with app downloads to guide profile-informed optimization on devices with similar characteristics.

entities.name: ProfileInstaller
entities.description: AndroidX library component that makes Baseline Profile data available to ART on supported devices.

entities.name: Linux userfaultfd
entities.description: Linux system call interface used by newer ART garbage-collection implementation work to coordinate page-fault handling and memory operations.

entities.name: AndroidX
entities.description: Set of Android libraries; releases can include Baseline Profiles for performance-sensitive library and application code.

entities.name: Jetpack Compose
entities.description: Declarative Android UI toolkit whose libraries can distribute Baseline Profiles to improve important execution paths.

entities.name: Application startup
entities.description: Time and work needed to create an app process, initialize ART and application state, load classes, and render initial UI.

entities.name: Runtime warm-up
entities.description: Execution period during which profiling, JIT compilation, caches, and adaptive runtime behavior can improve later performance.

entities.name: UI jank
entities.description: Visible stutter or missed frame deadlines, potentially influenced by GC pauses, compilation, startup work, scheduling, or application code.

entities.name: Mobile battery consumption
entities.description: Energy used by app execution and runtime work; compilation and execution strategy can trade installation or idle work against runtime energy.

entities.name: On-device code storage
entities.description: Persistent storage consumed by bytecode, profiles, compiled native code, and other app/runtime artifacts.

entities.name: Backward compatibility
entities.description: Ability to continue accepting the DEX input and app ecosystem expected by existing Android applications as runtime implementation changes.

entities.name: ART debugging support
entities.description: Runtime capabilities and tooling interfaces that support inspection, breakpoints, stack traces, and diagnosis of managed applications.

entities.name: ART runtime profiling
entities.description: Collection of execution information such as method hotness and timing used for performance analysis and optimization.

entities.name: ART and Android runtime security
entities.description: Security controls and integration points that constrain app execution through process isolation, permissions, verification, and managed-runtime safeguards.

entities.name: Application process isolation
entities.description: Use of distinct OS processes and Android security identities to isolate application execution and resources.

entities.name: Native machine-code execution
entities.description: Execution of target-CPU instructions produced by compilation or supplied by native libraries.

entities.name: Bytecode interpretation
entities.description: Execution strategy in which runtime instructions are decoded and performed by an interpreter rather than first being compiled to native code.

entities.name: Hybrid JIT/AOT execution
entities.description: ART strategy that combines adaptive JIT compilation during use with AOT compilation of profile-selected code when suitable.

entities.name: Profile-guided optimization
entities.description: Use of observed or supplied execution profiles to prioritize compilation and optimization of methods likely to affect performance.

entities.name: Garbage-collection pause
entities.description: Period when GC activity affects mutator execution; pause duration and frequency influence latency and UI smoothness.

entities.name: Managed object allocation
entities.description: Creation of managed objects in the ART heap, with allocation paths and collection pressure affecting application performance.

entities.name: Class metadata
entities.description: Runtime information about classes, methods, fields, types, and dispatch used for linking and execution.

entities.name: Method dispatch
entities.description: Runtime selection of the implementation to execute for a method invocation, including virtual/interface dispatch where applicable.

entities.name: Reflection
entities.description: Dynamic inspection or invocation of classes, methods, and fields, supported through Android's managed runtime APIs and constrained by platform rules.

entities.name: Exception handling
entities.description: Runtime support for throwing, propagating, and catching managed exceptions and producing diagnostic stack traces.

entities.name: Android Debug Bridge (ADB)
entities.description: Command-line tool used to communicate with Android devices and emulators for installation, debugging, logging, and shell access.

entities.name: Android Studio
entities.description: Android development environment integrating build, debugging, profiling, emulator, and deployment workflows.

entities.name: Android Studio Profiler
entities.description: Tooling for examining application CPU, memory, energy, and related runtime behavior.

entities.name: Logcat
entities.description: Android logging system and viewer used to inspect runtime and application logs.

entities.name: Android Emulator
entities.description: Virtual Android device used for app development and testing; ART behavior depends on the emulated Android image and CPU architecture.

entities.name: ARM64 / AArch64
entities.description: 64-bit Arm architecture targeted by Android devices and supported by ART compilation and native libraries.

entities.name: x86 architecture
entities.description: Intel-compatible architecture used by some Android devices and emulator images and supported as a runtime compilation target where configured.

entities.name: RISC-V architecture
entities.description: Open instruction-set architecture listed among ART's supported platforms in the supplied source; actual device and release support is version-dependent.

entities.name: Android release version
entities.description: Versioned Android platform whose ART implementation, compiler policy, libraries, GC, and modular update behavior may differ.

entities.name: Android 4.4 KitKat
entities.description: Release that introduced ART as a technology preview while Dalvik remained the default runtime.

entities.name: Android 5.0 Lollipop
entities.description: Release that replaced Dalvik with ART as Android's default runtime.

entities.name: Android 7.0 Nougat
entities.description: Release that made ART use a hybrid JIT/AOT approach, introduced profiling-guided JIT compilation, and moved from Apache Harmony to OpenJDK-derived libraries.

entities.name: Android 9 Pie
entities.description: Release associated with compressed DEX files and Google Play cloud profiles for better storage use and profile-guided optimization.

entities.name: Android 12
entities.description: Release whose ART component can receive updates through Android's Mainline architecture on supported devices.

entities.name: Android 13
entities.description: Release associated in the supplied source with a new ART garbage collector using Linux userfaultfd.

entities.name: Application installation time
entities.description: Stage when an APK is installed and ART-related compilation or preparation may occur, depending on device policy and available profiles.

entities.name: Device idle and charging state
entities.description: Condition used by ART's compilation policy in the described hybrid workflow to perform AOT work on hot code while the device is idle and charging.

entities.name: Hot code
entities.description: Methods or code paths frequently executed or important to UI-thread work and startup performance, identified through profiles.

entities.name: Cold code
entities.description: Infrequently executed code that may be left uncompiled or handled by interpretation/JIT to avoid unnecessary compilation and storage costs.

entities.name: DEX/runtime caches
entities.description: Runtime caches and resolved references that reduce repeated lookup or execution overhead.

entities.name: Compiled code cache
entities.description: Storage and management of compiled native code and related artifacts used to avoid repeated compilation.

entities.name: AndroidManifest.xml
entities.description: Application manifest describing app components, permissions, package-level configuration, and other metadata consumed by Android tooling and system services.

entities.name: Android resources
entities.description: Non-code app assets such as layouts, strings, images, and other resources packaged and resolved through Android resource infrastructure.

entities.name: App bundle delivery
entities.description: Distribution flow that can produce device-specific APKs and include optimization profile data where supported.

entities.name: Android native ABI
entities.description: Architecture-specific calling conventions and binary compatibility requirements for native libraries and generated machine code.

entities.name: JNI references
entities.description: Handles used to refer to managed objects from native code, with lifetime and thread rules enforced by JNI/ART.

entities.name: Android NDK
entities.description: Toolchain and headers for building native Android code, including C/C++ libraries that can interoperate with managed code.

entities.name: Android app lifecycle
entities.description: Framework-defined creation, foreground/background, pause, stop, and destruction states that shape when code runs and resources are used.

entities.name: Low-memory condition
entities.description: System state in which memory pressure may trigger reclamation or app process termination; GC behavior can influence risk and responsiveness.

entities.name: ART runtime update
entities.description: Delivery and application of runtime changes, including supported modular ART updates without requiring a complete OS update.

entities.name: Compiled ART artifact
entities.description: Device-specific output of ART compilation, such as native compiled code and associated metadata derived from DEX and profiles.

entities.name: classes.dex / DEX payload
entities.description: DEX bytecode file or set of DEX files packaged inside an APK, serving as ART's managed-code input.

entities.name: JVM class file
entities.description: Intermediate output from Java/Kotlin compilation that is transformed into DEX for conventional Android app packaging.

entities.name: Android app components
entities.description: Activities, services, broadcast receivers, and content providers managed by the Android framework and executed within application processes.

entities.name: ART initialization and startup
entities.description: Initialization of runtime structures, core libraries, class loading, and app execution environment during process startup.

entities.name: Compiler optimization
entities.description: Transformations applied during JIT/AOT compilation to improve execution efficiency while preserving program behavior.

entities.name: Deoptimization
entities.description: Transition from optimized compiled code to a less-optimized execution mode when assumptions or runtime conditions require it.

entities.name: DEX verification
entities.description: Validation of bytecode structure and type-safety-related properties as part of runtime or build/install processing, subject to Android version and implementation.

entities.name: Native crash
entities.description: Failure in native code or runtime-native components, typically diagnosed using tombstones, stack traces, and native debugging tools.

entities.name: Managed exception
entities.description: Exceptional managed-code control flow propagated by ART and application/framework code.

entities.name: Compilation performance trade-off
entities.description: Balance among install latency, first-run latency, throughput, memory use, storage consumption, and battery energy in ART compilation policies.

entities.name: Google
entities.description: Technology company that develops Android and ART.

entities.name: C++
entities.description: Programming language used to implement ART according to the supplied article.

entities.name: Apache License 2.0
entities.description: Permissive open-source license listed for ART.

entities.name: Android Open Source Project runtime documentation
entities.description: Official documentation describing ART and Android runtime behavior.

entities.name: ART source repository
entities.description: Source repository for the Android Runtime implementation.

entities.name: ART runtime performance
entities.description: Combined runtime concerns including throughput, latency, startup, energy, memory, and storage.
